verdict.rationale: An in-product AI insights feature is a fair question for a GPU cloud console, so the axis applies. The only relevant evidence is a single first-party line naming a 'Mission Control Agent' (and an MCP server) for 'investigating your environment and making supported changes' [coreweave-docs-62]. That is the product's own agent analyzing the customer's environment, so it counts as thin, glancing support rather than an adjacent feature. The reviewer is right that the line never explicitly says the agent generates insights or suggestions from customer data, which is why quality is minimal and confidence low. The Grafana dashboards and billing breakdowns elsewhere in the pack are not AI-generated and earn no credit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the agent produces AI-generated insights or recommendations from user data (telemetry, usage, workloads), a description of how insights surface in the Cloud Console, examples of suggestion output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
